title: Coupled-Parameter PINN for Relativistic Electron Dynamics in Gaussian Laser Fields
description:
Companion code for the Plasma Physics and Controlled Fusion paper “Relativistic Electron Dynamics in Gaussian Laser Fields: Coupled-Parameter Theory, Multi-Regime Analysis, and Physics-Informed Neural Network Modeling”.

Contents: coupled-parameter (rapidity) kinematics in Lobachevsky geometry; a high-accuracy DOP853 solver for the Lorentz force in a Gaussian pulse with linear, circular, elliptical, Laguerre-Gauss (OAM) and mixed polarizations, a co-axial static magnetic field, and an optional Landau-Lifshitz radiation-reaction term; radiation spectra and Liénard-Wiechert angular distributions; a Lorentz-invariant-constrained physics-informed neural network with soft- and hard-constraint variants and a curriculum trainer for the ultrarelativistic regime; a Gaussian-process surrogate for the spectral linewidth; and scripts regenerating every figure of the paper together with the numerical data behind them.

Code is released under the MIT licence; trained checkpoints and reference data under CC BY 4.0.
